title: hedyotis puberula
intro: Hedyotis puberula, commonly known as the hairy alpine, is a flowering plant species belonging to the Rubiaceae family. This plant is traditionally used for its medicinal properties, with reported health benefits including the treatment of fever, rheumatism, and digestive issues. The therapeutic actions of Hedyotis puberula are attributed to its ability to reduce inflammation, improve circulation, and act as an antimicrobial agent. Research has identified bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids as responsible for its medicinal properties, including its antioxidant and anti-inflammatory effects.
